request.auth_query: Existing owner permission, family and warehouse scope unchanged; header is not authorization

compatibility: Without header, the existing p12-documents-read-v2 timeline is unchanged. Do not apply this header globally or send to lists/warranty/commands/receipts. Existing owner contract and status/ETag are unchanged; meta.p12.timeline_contract identifies this extension, not meta.contract=p12-mixed-documents-v3.

milestone_fields.availability: RECORDED when exact scoped handoff exists, otherwise NOT_RECORDED; not proof the historical action never happened
milestone_fields.occurred_at: Exact RFC3339 UTC Z from existing p13.current_handoff.submitted_at; null when no persisted handoff
milestone_fields.event_id: null; the handoff PK is a business document ID, not a synthetic event ID
milestone_fields.actor: null; the handoff table does not persist historical actor identity/label/job title
milestone_fields.description: null; no raw note, notification body or caller metadata is substituted
milestone_fields.source_record: Present only when recorded: table, document_id, warehouse_id, document_version_at_record from the handoff; never request/session journal IDs

mapping.sent_to_web: User specified use of persisted handoff timestamp. The new table records the owner RECORD submission intent, not transport delivery acknowledgment, human review or WAL commit time.
mapping.checked: User specified a separate human confirmation, not validation at RECORD. No CHECK owner/event exists in the accepted source; retain SOURCE_MAPPING_PENDING/null. No new CHECK mutation is introduced.
mapping.created_posted: Existing source timestamp fields unchanged; posted_at remains nullable and warranty remains outside this extension.
mapping.terminal_state: Submission time stays historical even after canonical POSTED/CANCELLED; never overwrite current state or claim still waiting.
mapping.private_receipt: Do not derive from another family or expose mini_app_draft_receipts.response_body. Warehouse-readable handoff is separate from session-private RECORD receipt.
mapping.legacy: No backfill. Prior documents without persisted handoff remain NOT_RECORDED. Do not use SCANNING, counters, status_history aliases, doc_no, current lookup or now().

errors.422: P12_TIMELINE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED for unsupported source/mode/header on a handled owner read

remaining: Authoritative job-title master and future notification snapshot owner
Separate CHECK evidence owner/command if approved
Exact release and authenticated same-document TEST read
